//: Runs the real application in a GitHub Codespace so it can be opened from a link.
Nothing is rewritten for the web: this is app/server.py, the same engine the
desktop window uses, with GitHub forwarding the port.
Test data only. A Codespace is a container on GitHub's machines, so anything
typed into it has left this office. Use the SAMPLE answers; real matters belong
on the office's own computer. See docs/CODESPACES.md.
name: Adoption Filing Generator
postCreateCommand: pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && python -m app.cli check
